Name: Luna Moths for Custom Critters
Author: PixelHag
Description:
Luna Moths is a content pack for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1255]Custom Critters[/url] by spacechase0﻿ (yes, it's 1.6 compatible). It adds little, slightly transparent, glowing moths to the game that are loosely based on the real critter. These are purely aesthetic and are not interactive.

[center][font=Arial][color=#ffe599][size=5]Luna Moths in Action[/size][/color][/font]

[color=#b4a7d6][size=6][u]Installation:[/u][/size][/color] 
[list]
[*]Download and install  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1255]Custom Critters[/url] by spacechase0. 
[*][color=#f6b26b][size=4][b]MANUALLY DOWNLOAD[/b][/size][/color] Luna Moths. 
[*]Unzip and open up the [i]Luna Moths for Custom Critters[/i] folder.
[*]There are 2 folders; [i]Luna Moths - Large Maps[/i] and [i]Luna Moths - Small Maps[/i]. This is so your small maps won't be overrun with moths, but your bigger maps will still have plenty of spawns.
[*]Copy or cut both folders and place them into the [i]Critters[/i] folder inside of Custom Critters. (If this is your first time downloading Custom Critters you will need to make a Critters folder. If this confuses you, please watch the video below.)
[/list]
                                                   [youtube]l30CvPAm5TI[/youtube]
[color=#a2c4c9][size=6]        If you're interested in learning more about how to customize Luna Moths, or any other critter, visit my [url=https://pixelhag.com/2024/04/05/sdv-pc-modding-configuring-custom-critters/]blog[/url]﻿!
[/size][/color]

[/left]
